Where we begin

Does your website still reflect your business?

Start with the questions visitors need answered, then look at what makes the website harder to understand or keep current.

Everyday updates become difficult

Editable sections give your team a practical place to update services, people and stories after launch.

How it works

A process you can follow.

Discover. Create. Improve.

Understand the business first

Before we begin

A few useful answers.

Where does a website project start?+
Start with the audience, the main offer and the questions customers ask. These shape the brief and page plan.
Can our team update the content?+
The demo uses editable Joomla articles and modules. Your team can replace words, images, links and section content through the admin.
What do we need to prepare?+
Bring your service information, brand assets and photographs you have permission to use. Agree who will review and approve the content.
How are scope and pricing agreed?+
Confirm the deliverables, responsibilities and support needed for your project. The plans on this demo are illustrative examples.
Can you work with an existing website?+
An existing site can provide useful content and evidence about the customer journey. Review what to keep before deciding what to change.
